thread:
Sam (Sales): Hey team — Novanet POC demo next Tue needs a temporary bump to the Dedicated pool burst. Can we increase burst capacity for pool `dedicated-novanet-02` for a 2-hour window during the demo? Need guidance on config + any pricing/prorate implications.
Alex (Eng-Platform): Which region and model are they using? Also what's your expected qps/peak tokens/sec?
Sam (Sales): Region: us-west-2, model: redwood-3b-quant, expected peak ~450 qps, ~6k tokens/sec during the demo ramp. Demo window 2026-03-31 16:00-18:00 UTC.
Priya (Solutions Eng): For that load we'll likely need extra burst nodes or a temporary commit increase. Two options: 1) short-term burst nodes (auto-fallback to hosted if capacity) or 2) temporary reserved capacity uplift for the week. Which does the customer prefer on billing?
Sam (Sales): They prefer to avoid a full-week commit if possible — short-term burst is preferred. Also Novanet is asking if the burst will guarantee isolation (no cross-tenant noise).
Maria (SRE): Short-term burst is fine but not a hard isolation SLA. Burst nodes are still part of the Dedicated pool and share host-level resources; we can pin GPUs to the pool during the window for stronger isolation but that is effectively a short-term reservation. That requires a change ticket and will be billed as reserved for the duration.
Alex (Eng-Platform): If you want the safest route, we can provision 2x p4d-equivalent nodes for the 2-hour window and attach them to `dedicated-novanet-02`. Quick config I recommend we apply: 
```
"burst_policy": {
  "enabled": true,
  "max_burst_nodes": 2,
  "burst_window_sec": 7200,
  "cooldown_sec": 3600
}
```
This keeps autoscaler behavior predictable. If you want pinned nodes (no sharing), change to `pinned_reservation: true` and we'll create a short-lived reservation.
Priya (Solutions Eng): From the presales side, note the customer will need a signed amendment for short reservation and confirmation on prorated billing. Ops: does billing prorate partial-hour reservations?
infra-bot: Reservation ticket created: #INC-32418 — temporary-reservation-dedicated-novanet-02. Owner: @Maria (SRE). ETA for provisioning: 3h (pending approvals).
Maria (SRE): Confirming — we can do pinned reservation for the 2-hour window. Billing will invoice as prorated daily reservation (finance will treat it as a same-day short reservation; expect a minimum billing granularity of 1 hour for reserved nodes). I'll loop in finance if they need exact numbers.
Sam (Sales): Ok please proceed with pinned reservation for demo window. Also we need a runbook for fallback: if capacity fails, route to hosted fallback model `redwood-3b-quant-hosted` with degraded latency. Priya — can you draft the fallback snippet for the customer?
Priya (Solutions Eng): Yep, will send a short fallback snippet and a one-page runbook to the customer. Quick note on network: Novanet requires VPC peering + egress control. Ops — will the short reservation change network or IAM?
Alex (Eng-Platform): No network change needed if they use existing Dedicated VPC endpoints. For pinning we'll need to ensure the instance attaches to the same subnet and inherits the pool's IAM role. If they need a new VPC peering, that's separate and takes longer.
Maria (SRE): I'll start the reservation and tag it with `poc:novanet` and `billing:prorate`. infra-bot will update the thread when provisioned.
infra-bot: Provisioning started for reservation INC-32418. Expected ready: 2026-03-31T15:05:00Z.
Sam (Sales): Great — please confirm when done. Also adding a quick pricing Q: is the short reservation charged at the committed Dedicated rate or at an elevated burst rate?
Maria (SRE): It will be charged as a prorated reserved node at the Dedicated reserved rate (not burst overage), since we're pinning the nodes. If you had chosen non-pinned burst, overage pricing might apply.
Sam (Sales): Perfect, that helps for the sales quote. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Alex (Eng-Platform): I'll also add an autoscaler guardrail to ensure we don't scale the rest of the pool down below baseline during the pinned window.
infra-bot: Reservation INC-32418 completed and nodes attached to dedicated-novanet-02.
Sam (Sales): Confirmed with Novanet — they got access and the demo window is covered. Closing this thread after post-demo cost reconciliation.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll drop the fallback snippet and the runbook in the customer thread and tag @Sam.
Sam (Sales): Thanks all.
